spec_family.name: Interior Drywall Walls - Repaint - Latex over Latex
spec_family.description: Complete wall repaint specification for interior drywall surfaces with existing latex coating, using latex finish system. Covers protection, prep, repair, application, and cleanup for QL-3 through QL-5.

required_inputs.description: Linear feet of wall-to-ceiling boundary requiring cut-in
Linear feet of wall-to-trim boundary (baseboard, casing, crown)
Linear feet of wall-to-asset boundary (cabinets, tile, built-ins)
Floor area requiring protection in work zones
Whether the space is occupied during painting

configuration_dimensions.description: Quality tier determining prep scope and coat count

paintable_items.name: Wall Field Area
paintable_items.counting_rules: Total paintable wall surface area from PS_SURFACE_SF.WALL_FIELD. Opening deductions handled by PaintScope.

paintable_items.name: Ceiling Cut-In Edge
paintable_items.counting_rules: Linear feet of wall-to-ceiling boundary from PS_EDGE_LF.TO_CEILING
paintable_items.notes: Included in wall SF labor; tracked for complexity assessment

paintable_items.name: Trim Cut-In Edge
paintable_items.counting_rules: Linear feet of wall-to-trim boundary from PS_EDGE_LF.TO_TRIM
paintable_items.notes: Baseboard top edge, casing edges, crown edges

paintable_items.name: Asset Cut-In Edge
paintable_items.counting_rules: Linear feet of wall-to-asset boundary from PS_EDGE_LF.TO_ASSET
paintable_items.notes: Edges at cabinets, tile, built-ins requiring precision cut

paintable_items.name: Floor Protection Area
paintable_items.counting_rules: Floor area in work zones from PS_PROTECT_SF.FLOOR_EXPOSED

variants.notes: Basic single-coat refresh for budget repaints or rental turnover
Standard two-coat repaint with prep and repair for typical residential
Premium two-coat with comprehensive prep, inspection, and extra care

adjacency_requirements.notes: Standard freehand brush cut; tape only if ceiling is contrasting color
Freehand cut to baseboard, casing, crown; trim typically contrasting
Precision cut at cabinets, tile, built-ins; mask high-value assets

assumptions: Existing coating is standard interior latex in acceptable condition (no peeling, minimal chalking)
No lead paint or hazardous material present
Standard ceiling height (8-10 ft); high ceilings require modifier
Walls are accessible without major furniture moves (basic clearing assumed)
Temperature and humidity within latex application range (50-85F, <85% RH)
Color change is standard (similar or darker); extreme changes require assessment
No structural damage, water damage, or mold present
exclusions: Wallpaper removal or skim coating over wallpaper residue
Lead paint testing, abatement, or encapsulation
Furniture moving beyond basic room clearing
Structural or drywall repairs beyond minor cosmetic (>4 inch patches)
Primer coats (latex-over-latex does not require full prime unless specified)
